camera_notes: Filmed from far away in low light, so toe point and exact knee angles are estimates. Next time, film side-on, closer, at her height.
overall_message: You go for the whole pass with no hesitation, every flip finishes, and your last landing is clean. The points you're losing come from body shape, not fear or rotation.

wins.title: Textbook hurdle
wins.detail: Arms go right up by your ears.

wins.title: Clean finish
wins.detail: Feet together, no extra steps, arms up and held.

top_fix.problem: Right after your round-off you land folded over with your chest down, so you have to sit back into the back handspring.
top_fix.goal: End the round-off with feet together, chest up and arms by your ears, so the handspring starts from a bounce.

drills.name: Round-off rebound
drills.how: Round-off, then a straight jump with arms up, then stick it on a panel mat. 5–10 reps.

drills.name: Handstand snap-downs
drills.how: From a handstand against a wall or off a block, snap both feet down together and bounce. 3 sets of 5.

next_fix: Straight knees in the back handspring.

key_frames.title: Round-off landing
key_frames.caption: Folded over with chest down. The #1 fix.
